Sound Familiar?

Clinic owners and office managers tell us the same things — medical, dental, physio, chiro, massage and optometry alike.

"Money comes in from five places."

Provincial billing, insurers, direct billing and patient payments at the front desk. Matching deposits to visits takes days.

"I hope the splits are right."

Each associate has a different split or overhead arrangement. You do the math in a spreadsheet and hope nobody asks.

"Is she a contractor or an employee?"

Some practitioners invoice you, others are on payroll with the front desk and assistants. It is easy to get wrong.

"GST? On some things, I think."

Most health services are exempt. Products and some services are not. You are not sure where your line is.

"Month-end is chaos."

Rent, equipment, supplies, payouts and payroll all land at once. The books are always weeks behind.

"Which part of the clinic makes money?"

You know total revenue. You do not know which practitioner or service line actually pays the lease.

Clinic Bookkeeping FAQ

Do you do bookkeeping for dental, physio and chiropractic clinics?

Yes. We keep the books for the clinic as a business — medical, dental, physio, chiropractic, massage and optometry clinics with several practitioners. The same work applies: deposits from many payers, practitioner payouts, payroll and GST.

How much does bookkeeping for a medical clinic in Winnipeg cost?

Most multi-practitioner clinics fit our Bookkeeping & Tax plan at $499/month, with payroll for up to 10 employees. Larger clinics may fit Financial Management at $2,599/month. Small clinics can start at $299/month. Jennifer confirms your fit on a free call.

Can you track profit by practitioner or service line?

Yes. We set up your books so revenue and costs can be seen by practitioner and by service line. On the call, Jennifer explains how this works for your clinic.

Do medical and dental clinics charge GST?

Most health care services from licensed practitioners are GST-exempt, but some products and services are taxable. The line depends on what your clinic sells. We review your sales and file your GST/PST returns.

How do you handle practitioner splits and overhead sharing?

We record each associate's split or expense-sharing arrangement the same way every month, so payouts match the agreement and your books show the real clinic profit.

Can you run payroll for our front desk and assistants?

Yes. Payroll is included in our plans (up to 10 employees on Bookkeeping & Tax), with T4 filing. Payroll on its own starts at $99/month.

Our clinic's books are behind. Can you still help?

Yes. We help businesses get current, recover missing documents, file or amend overdue taxes and handle CRA communication. Then monthly bookkeeping keeps you current.
